sentences.en: Before starting the run, you should check your heart rate.
sentences.zh: 跑步前你应该检查一下心率。

sentences.en: The doctor advised me to monitor my heart rate during exercise.
sentences.zh: 医生建议我在运动时监测心率。

sentences.en: His heart rate is too high; we need to call an ambulance immediately.
sentences.zh: 他的心率太高了，我们需要立即叫救护车。
